about.p1: Rubicón began with a wood-fired oven, an inherited sourdough starter and a habit of never rushing. Today we are a small team, but we still do things the same way: long fermentations, local flour and nothing you cannot pronounce.
about.p2: Drop by early and you will see us taking out the first loaves. Come in the afternoon and we will already be working on tomorrow's puff pastry. Here, bread is made in plain sight.

legal.cookies.title: Cookie policy
legal.cookies.s1.title: 1. What cookies are
legal.cookies.s1.p1: Cookies are small files that a website stores in your browser to remember information about your visit. Some are essential for the website to work; others are only set if you allow them.
legal.cookies.s2.title: 2. Which cookies we use
legal.cookies.s2.p1: This website only uses the cookies listed in the table. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.
legal.cookies.table.purposeMap: Show the interactive map and remember your Google preferences
legal.cookies.table.purposeSecurity: Security and abuse prevention on the map
legal.cookies.s3.title: 3. How to manage your consent
legal.cookies.s3.p1: The first time you visit we ask whether you accept third-party map cookies. You can accept, reject or configure them, and change your mind at any time from the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of the page.
legal.cookies.s3.p2: If you reject them, the website works the same: you will just see an illustrated map instead of the interactive Google map.
legal.cookies.s4.title: 4. How to delete them from your browser
legal.cookies.s4.p1: You can also delete or block cookies from your browser settings. Please note that if you block technical cookies, we will ask you again on every visit.
legal.cookies.s5.title: 5. Changes to this policy
legal.cookies.s5.p1: If we change the cookies we use, we will update this page and ask for your consent again when needed.
legal.notice.title: Legal notice
legal.notice.s1.title: 1. Owner details
legal.notice.s1.p1: In accordance with Spanish Law 34/2002 on information society services and e-commerce (LSSI), these are the details of the owner of this website.
legal.notice.table.registryValue: Madrid Companies Registry, volume 0000, folio 00, sheet M-000000
legal.notice.s2.title: 2. Purpose of the website
legal.notice.s2.p1: This website is informative: it introduces the bakery, its products, its team and how to visit us. It does not allow purchases or reservations.
legal.notice.s3.title: 3. Prices
legal.notice.s3.p1: Prices shown are a guide, include VAT and may change. The valid price is the one displayed in the shop at the time of purchase.
legal.notice.s4.title: 4. Intellectual property
legal.notice.s4.p1: The texts, photographs, logos and design of this website belong to Panadería Rubicón or are used with their authors' permission. They may not be reproduced without authorisation.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Data controller
legal.privacy.s1.p1: The controller of your data is Panadería Rubicón, S.L., located at {address}. You can write to us at {email}.
legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. What data we process
legal.privacy.s2.p1: This website has no forms or sign-up. We only process your data if you write to us by email or WhatsApp, and only to reply to you.
legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. Your rights
legal.privacy.s3.p1: You can access, rectify or erase your data, and object to or restrict its processing, by writing to {email}. If you think we have not handled your request properly, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).
legal.accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
legal.accessibility.s1.title: 1. Commitment
legal.accessibility.s1.p1: Panadería Rubicón wants everyone to be able to use this website. That is why we designed it following the WCAG 2.2 guidelines at level AA.
legal.accessibility.s2.title: 2. Compliance status
legal.accessibility.s2.p1: This website is partially compliant with WCAG 2.2 AA due to the exceptions listed below.
legal.accessibility.s3.title: 3. Non-accessible content
legal.accessibility.s3.p1: The interactive map is provided by Google and is outside our control. As an alternative, the address and the “Get directions” link are always available as text.
legal.accessibility.s4.title: 4. Contact
legal.accessibility.s4.p1: If you find any barrier, write to us at {email} or call us on {phone}. We will reply within 20 working days at most.
